## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r setup, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = TRUE}

library(MCMCpack)
library(ggplot2)

# Section
# Parameters
alpha <- c(3, 4, 2, 5, 3)
p_like <- 0.6
N <- 1000

# Step 1: Generate proportions
p <- as.numeric(rdirichlet(1, alpha))

# Step 2: Sample counts per ethnicity
n_row <- as.numeric(rmultinom(1, N, prob = p))

# Step 3: Generate likes/dislikes
likes <- rbinom(length(n_row), size = n_row, prob = p_like)
dislikes <- n_row - likes

ct_dirichlet <- data.frame(
  Ethnicity = c("White", "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian", "Other"),
  Like = likes,
  Dislike = dislikes
)

print(ct_dirichlet)


# Section 
set.seed(123)
N <- 1000
ethnicities <- c("White", "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian", "Other")
pi <- c(0.3, 0.25, 0.2, 0.15, 0.1)
p_like <- 0.6

E <- sample(ethnicities, size = N, replace = TRUE, prob = pi)
P <- rbinom(N, 1, p_like)
Preference <- ifelse(P == 1, "Like", "Dislike")

ct_categorical <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(E, Preference))
print(ct_categorical)

library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)

ct_melt <- melt(ct_dirichlet, id.vars = "Ethnicity")
ggplot(ct_melt, aes(x = Ethnicity, y = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "red")) +
  labs(y = "Proportion", title = "Proportion of Likes and Dislikes by Ethnicity") +
  theme_minimal()

```
